age_qualification.note: The preceding rule book automatically qualifies players who have not turned 25 before July 1; retained provisionally pending the 2026-27 rule book.

european_elite_youth_exemption.note: European Elite games played while CHL-eligible, excluding the over-age year, are exempt; age 19 is the provisional birth-year implementation boundary.

methodology: Count preceding regular seasons only. Apply exact provider league treatments, split European Elite youth-exempt games, and calculate age on July 1. The 2026-27 policy remains provisional until the new-season rule book confirms inherited age and youth-exemption language.
